= field-filtering

== should use connection filter on field

.Schema
[source,graphql,schema=true]
----
type Movie @node {
  title: String!
  genres: [Genre!]! @relationship(type: "IN_GENRE", direction: OUT)
}

type Genre @node {
  name: String!
  series: [Series!]! @relationship(type: "IN_SERIES", direction: OUT)
}

type Series @node {
  name: String!
}
----

      series {

    }
  }
}
